messages.content: 一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離。在這段時間結束時，汽車的速度是多少？在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？

function.name: kinematics_calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

final_speed.description: The final speed of the object. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel. This is a float type value.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

We need to compute first part: starting from rest, distance 120 m in 10 s. We can find final speed using kinematics: distance = v0*t + 0.5*a*t^2. v0=0, so 120 = 0.5*a*100 => a = 240/100 = 2.4 m/s^2. Final speed after 10s: v = v0 + a*t = 0 + 2.4*10 = 24 m/s. So first part speed = 24 m/s.

Second part: accelerate 5s from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the initial speed? Wait: "from 12 m/s accelerate to final speed is initial speed's two times." The phrase: "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" Means starting at 12 m/s, accelerate to final speed that is twice the initial speed (the initial speed of second stage?). But also says "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" meaning final speed is twice the speed computed in first part. So final speed = 2 * 24 = 48 m/s. That matches "twice the initial speed"? Actually initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s, but final speed is 48 m/s, which is 4 times 12. So maybe misinterpretation. Let's parse: "在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。" So after reaching 24 m/s, car continues accelerating 5s, from 12 m/s to final speed that is twice the initial speed. But initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s? That seems contradictory because after first part, speed is 24 m/s, not 12. Maybe they mean after first part, car continues accelerating 5s, from 12 m/s to final speed that is twice the initial speed (i.e., 24 m/s). But then final speed would be 48 m/s? So maybe they mean after first part, car continues accelerating 5s, from 12 m/s to final speed that is twice the initial speed (maybe initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s). But then final speed would be 24 m/s, which is not twice the first part speed. So confusion.

Let's assume the scenario: After first part, car continues accelerating 5s, starting at 12 m/s, final speed is twice the initial speed of second stage (so 24 m/s). But then final speed is also twice the speed from first part? That would be 48 m/s. So inconsistent.

So maybe the phrase "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" refers to the initial speed of the whole problem (which is 12 m/s?), but we started from rest. So maybe they mean after first part, car continues accelerating 5s, starting at 12 m/s, final speed is twice the initial speed of the whole problem (which is 12 m/s), so final speed = 24 m/s. But then "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" would be wrong.

Then continues accelerating for 5 s, starting at 12 m/s, final speed is twice the initial speed of second stage (so 24 m/s). But also final speed is twice the speed from first part (so 48 m/s). So maybe the initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s, but final speed is twice the initial speed of second stage (24 m/s). But then final speed is also twice the speed from first part (48 m/s). So maybe the initial speed of second stage is 24 m/s, final speed is 48 m/s. But then why mention 12 m/s? Could be a mistake.

But then final speed is also twice the speed from first part? That would be 48 m/s. So no.
